ValidationRule.description: Status may not drop two or more ladder ranks, Cancelled can only reopen to Planning, and Completed requires approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), OR( CASE(TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) - CASE(TEXT(Status__c), 'Draft', 0, 'Planning', 1, 'Active', 2, 'On Hold', 2, 'Completed', 3, 'Cancelled', 3, -1) >= 2, AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Cancelled'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Planning'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), NOT(Is_Approved__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This status transition is not allowed.
